2607.11818.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
2607.11818.paper_summary: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces diverse, visually grounded scenarios through information-flow-guided planning and multi-stage quality filtering, yielding 258 human-verified nominal scenarios and 50 variants targeting interactive UI applications. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art models, from 4B open-weight to frontier proprietary systems, shows that current models still lack robust visual tool-calling capability: even the best model achieves below 50% success rate. Our failure analysis further reveals that visual precision, not only planning, is a primary bottleneck for capable models: 53% of failures stem from incorrect information extraction from images despite otherwise correct task workflows. A planning-to-precision crossover emerges with scale: smaller models fail at deciding what to do, while larger models fail at perceiving what they see, suggesting fundamentally different research directions for improving models at different capability levels. The framework and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox
2607.11818.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 MM-ToolSandBox，一個用於視覺基礎工具呼叫代理的基準和評估框架。<lb/>該框架提供了一個有狀態的執行環境，涵蓋了 500 多個工具，跨越 16 個應用領域，支持多圖像、多輪次的任務，代理必須將逐步到達的視覺輸入轉化為可執行的工具呼叫，同時處理現實的對話現象（目標修訂、錯誤修正、狀態變化）。<lb/>一個自動化的場景生成管道通過信息流引導的規劃和多階段質量過濾生成多樣化的、視覺基礎的場景，產生了 258 個經人類驗證的名義場景和 50 個針對互動 UI 應用的變體。<lb/>對 12 個最先進模型的評估，從 4B 開放權重到前沿專有系統，顯示當前模型仍然缺乏穩健的視覺工具呼叫能力：即使是最佳模型的成功率也低於 50%。<lb/>我們的失敗分析進一步揭示，視覺精確度，而不僅僅是規劃，是能夠模型的主要瓶頸：53% 的失敗源於從圖像中提取信息不正確，儘管任務工作流程在其他方面是正確的。<lb/>隨著規模的增長，出現了規劃與精確度的交叉：較小的模型在決定該做什麼時失敗，而較大的模型在感知它們所看到的時失敗，這表明改善不同能力水平模型的基本研究方向是不同的。<lb/>該框架和基準在 https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox 上公開可用。
